candidate_scope: Camera obstruction, sensor health drift and road-scene input anomalies
explicit_non_goals: Does not establish safe riding conditions or a validated flood-crossing depth
No steering, throttle or braking command from anomaly scores
required_gates: Require calibration, time sync, sensor health and conservative uncertainty handling
